author: vivirancy
name: quarantine
install_msg:
Thank you for installing quarantine!
Run `[p]quarantineset` to begin.
short: Quarantine members and talk to them in a private channel.
description: Quarantine members and talk to them in a private channel. A quarantined member loses access to all channels except a new private conversation channel where they can talk to mods. Quarantined chats are archived after the quarantine is lifted and attached to the modlog case. Modlog transcripts require vivi-cogs/ModLog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the ID and message history of members within its quarantined chats archive on disk. When vivi-cogs/ModLog is installed the transcript is also attached to the modlog case and uploaded to the modlog channel; Red's core modlog cannot store attachments, so on that fallback the transcript stays on disk only.
